name: tapjob-monorepo
description: JavaScript/TypeScript workspace root. Python services use the uv workspace in pyproject.toml.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run security:audit-gate:test && npm run deploy:validate-image:test && npm run deploy:require-ci-success:test
scripts.check:js: npm run tokens:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run python -m mypy && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:py
